## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is the 14-Day Operational Systems Diagnostic?
A comprehensive 14-day operational breakdown that identifies workflow inefficiencies, disconnected systems, wasted manual processes, and automation opportunities in your business. Investment: $7,500 flat ($535/day). If meaningful operational gaps are not identified, the engagement continues at no extra cost.

### How much does Aetheris AI consulting cost?
Services range from $50 for visual rendering to $25,000+ for custom AI implementation. Key tiers:
- Visual Rendering: $50–$400
- Rapid Digital Evaluation: $750
- Ongoing Digital Oversight: $1,500/month
- 14-Day Operational Diagnostic: $7,500
- Custom AI Implementation: $25,000+

### Does Aetheris AI serve businesses outside Indiana?
Yes. While headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Aetheris AI serves businesses across the entire United States with remote and on-site consulting engagements.

### How do I implement AI in my business?
Start with an AI Maturity Assessment to identify high-ROI use cases, then prioritize a small number of pilots that target measurable operational pain (manual data entry, slow lead routing, duplicate work). Aetheris AI's 14-Day Operational Diagnostic produces a prioritized roadmap and AI/automation plan.

### What is an AI maturity assessment?
A structured evaluation of how prepared an organization is to adopt AI — covering data quality, process maturity, team capability, infrastructure, and governance. Aetheris AI offers a free 2-minute AI Readiness Assessment at https://aetheris.technology/assessment.

### How do I reduce operational costs with AI?
The fastest gains come from: (1) automating repetitive workflows (CRM updates, lead routing, reporting), (2) deploying AI agents for inbound triage and follow-up, (3) using LLMs to compress knowledge work (drafting, summarization), (4) replacing manual reporting with real-time data analytics dashboards.

### What industries does Aetheris AI serve?
Healthcare, Finance, Logistics, Construction, Manufacturing, Legal, Real Estate, E-commerce, SaaS, and Professional Services.

### Build vs. buy AI: which should I choose?
Buy when the use case is commodity (chatbots, transcription, generic copilots). Build when the AI is core to your competitive advantage, requires proprietary data, or must integrate deeply with bespoke workflows. Aetheris AI provides Build vs. Buy Analysis as part of strategy consulting.

3. Choose engagement tier based on operational pain: Rapid Evaluation ($750), 14-Day Diagnostic ($7,500), or Custom Implementation ($25,000+).
4. Receive prioritized roadmap, ROI projection, and AI implementation plan.
